description:

**Title And Summary**
 Lead Product Manager \- Technical
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.

**Overview**
 The Mastercard Dispute Lifecycle team in Pune have an exciting opportunity for a Lead Product Management \- Technical to help further enhance and modernize our Dispute management platform.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will quickly develop a deep technical understanding of the applications and systems they support, demonstrating a willingness to dive in, challenge assumptions, and ask thoughtful, probing questions to ensure plans are executed effectively and efficiently.
   

  

 They will bring a strong interest in Payments domain, along with proven technical leadership, and the ability to think creatively applying innovative, out\-of\-the\-box approaches to solve complex problems
   

  

 Role
   

  

* Customer obsession: Champion a deep understanding of customer needs, the broader ecosystem, and key market dynamics, and embed these insights into product decisions
* Systems analysis \& design: Develop an in\-depth understanding of the product platform and its surrounding ecosystem; produce high\-quality functional artifacts for Engineering, including data flows, sequence diagrams, APIs, and interface specifications
* Backlog management: Define and maintain a clear roadmap aligned to business objectives; translate system designs into well\-structured features and user stories that are ready for Engineering execution
* Story elaboration: Lead refinement sessions and create detailed, comprehensive acceptance criteria to ensure clarity and delivery readiness
* Technical analysis: Provide rigorous analysis of application software to validate that business and functional requirements can be effectively delivered
* Strategic alignment: Partner with stakeholders to ensure backlogs are prioritized and refined based on business value, impact, and measurable outcomes
* Agile mindset: Advocate for and model agile best practices across the product lifecycle—from defining epics to writing actionable user stories and acceptance criteria
* Continuous improvement: Measure outcomes, evaluate existing practices and metrics, and drive ongoing optimization across processes, roles, and delivery execution


**All About You**
* Proven product experience: Several years of product management or new product development experience delivering high\-quality products, with the ability to clearly articulate business context and customer use cases
* Technical product expertise: Experience managing highly technical platforms or API\-driven services, with strong software architecture and systems design knowledge
* ISO8583 knowledge (preferred): Familiarity with key payments and dispute management concepts is a plus
* Lean \& Agile delivery: Hands\-on experience with Lean product management and agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), along with CI/CD and modern DevOps practices
* End\-to\-end ownership: Demonstrated success delivering features from design through development, deployment, and customer integration
* Backlog management: Expertise in grooming epics, features, and user stories; defining clear acceptance and exit criteria; and effectively prioritizing platform backlogs
* Data\-driven decision making: Ability to define and leverage SMART metrics (leading and lagging) to guide product strategy and measure success
* Collaboration \& stakeholder management: Proven ability to work across global, cross\-functional teams, align diverse perspectives, and manage dependencies and co\-development opportunities
* Thrives in ambiguity: Comfortable navigating uncertainty; proactively identifies solutions, engages the right stakeholders, and drives clarity
* Continuous improvement \& communication: Committed to optimizing team processes for speed, quality, and innovation, with excellent written and verbal communication skills

 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

 We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. **Job Title**
 Advisor, Product Delivery
   

  

**What does a successful Product Owner do at Fiserv?**
 The Product Owner (PO) s responsible for maximizing the value delivered by the team and ensuring that the Team Backlog is aligned with customer and stakeholder needs. The PO is the team’s primary customer advocate and primary link to business and technology strategy. This enables the team to balance the needs of multiple stakeholders while continuously evolving the Solution.
   

  

 The PO represents the needs of customers and the business within a particular Solution domain, which is typically co\-represented by a Product Manager. Together, they ensure that product strategy and implementation remain connected throughout the value stream. Serving as the ‘voice of the customer’ for the team entails a broad range of responsibilities. The PO must build and manage key relationships, synthesize information from multiple sources, maintain business alignment in the Team Backlog, and communicate effectively with a variety of audiences—all with a bias toward delivering, and learning, quickly.
   

  

 The PO is ultimately responsible for maximizing the value delivered by the Agile team, which requires the PO to ensure that the right solutions are built and that they are built the right way. However, the PO cannot accomplish this alone. Building the right solutions requires deep knowledge of business strategy, customer segments, market dynamics, and value stream economics. The PO establishes a close relationship with Product Management to derive these macro\-level insights and apply them to specific product domains. Building solutions the right way requires Team and Technical Agility, DevOps practices, and a Continuous Delivery Pipeline. These technical capabilities determine the speed and quality with which value can be delivered, and the PO relies on the Agile team to provide them. The PO provides a crucial link in the bi\-directional information flow between Product Management and the Agile team. As shown in Figure 2, the PO keeps the Agile team informed of the strategy that drives product design and keeps Product Management informed of the innovations that influence the evolution of product strategy. Customer feedback aligns thinking from strategy through execution and is accessible to all roles.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* The PO, in close partnership with Product Management, applies a customer\-centric mindset along with design thinking tools to guide the team toward delivering solutions that are desirable, viable, feasible, and sustainable.
* The PO must understand what solutions and experiences the teams can deliver. This practical insight is a valuable contribution to the vision and roadmaps that guide solution implementation.
* In collaboration with Product Management, System Architects, Delivery Management and other stakeholders, POs help guide the sequencing of features over time toward the best economic outcomes. Through their understanding of which problems need to be solved, which solutions would best solve them, and the feasibility of delivering those solutions, POs help ensure that the vision and roadmap are reflected in the Jira Project Backlog.
* The PO should communicate the vision and roadmap during PI Planning to ensure teams are aligned and ready to execute against them.
* It is the PO’s responsibility to ensure that they are well\-formed and aligned with product strategy. The PO clarifies story details, applies user\-story voice, ensures ‘INVEST’ characteristics are present, assists with story splitting, defines enablers, and incorporates behavior\-driven design (BDD) to ensure stories support continuous value flow. The PO also allows space for ‘local’ stories and spikes that advance product design but are not derived explicitly from the strategic roadmap.
* Achieving continuous value flow requires that the highest\-value backlog items are delivered in the shortest sustainable lead time and in the right sequence. The PO enables this by regularly ordering backlog items according to their cost of delay and communicating that sequence to the team during backlog refinement
* The PO works with the team to agree on accepted story completion. This includes validating that the story meets acceptance criteria, that it has the appropriate, persistent acceptance tests, and that it otherwise complies with its Definition of Done (DoD). In so doing, the PO assures that quality is built in.
* POs facilitate frequent conversations with their teams to resolve questions, manage dependencies, and communicate priorities that emerge as stories are implemented. This information also helps the team slice stories effectively to achieve increased velocity and shortened learning cycles.
* The PO regularly evaluates progress toward story acceptance criteria, including compliance with Built\-In\-Quality criteria, such as the scalable definition of done, and non\-functional requirements (NFRs). The PO works closely with the team to detect quality issues as they are introduced and correct them in or near real time.
* As a member of the Agile team, the PO attends and actively participates in team events during PI execution. During iteration planning, backlog refinement, iteration reviews, team retrospectives, and team syncs, the PO provides crucial feedback on the team’s work from an outside\-in, customer\-centric point of view. By participating in PO Sync and System Demos, the PO helps the team satisfy dependencies, demonstrate incremental value, and maintain cadence with the roadmap.
* The PO collects and shares feedback with Product Management and System Architects as part of Continuous Exploration, with their teams during backlog refinement, iteration planning, and iteration reviews, system demos, and, if applicable, Inspect and Adapt events.

As a world leader in virtual interlining technology, Tripstack connects non\-partner, low\-cost and full\-service carriers, enabling the creation of unique and flexible itineraries through a simple, cost\-effective API.

 www.tripstack.com
   

  

 www.etraveligroup.com
   

  

 The role
   

  

 As a Product Owner at Tripstack, you'll report into a Product Manager serving as an operational leader and product strategist for your portfolio within the Content Acquisition team.
   

  

 You will oversee the integration and operation of flight content into our platform, ensuring we maintain world\-leading content at the highest possible quality while keeping our systems stable and performant.
   

  

 Job Responsibilities
   

  

**Operational Leadership \& Incident Management**
* Own end\-to\-end operational performance of your assigned content portfolio (APIs, consolidators, or scrapes), ensuring system stability, SLA adherence, and production health
* Lead incident management and structured RCA (root cause analysis) investigations for any issues; drive resolution tracking and prevention of recurring production issues
* Define, monitor, and proactively manage operational KPIs: uptime, latency, booking failures, error rates, conversion impact, and portfolio risks
* Act as primary operational escalation point for airline\-related issues, coordinating rapidly across engineering, product teams, and external airline partners


**Cross\-Functional Coordination \& Priority Management**
* Facilitate resource planning and allocation decisions with your engineering team; identify constraints and trade\-offs
* Manage the balance between competing priorities (new feature development, production support, incident response, and ad\-hoc requests)
* Define and communicate clear priorities to engineering teams \- including what gets deprioritized and why
* Coordinate all team standups, sprint planning, ROMs (Rough Order of Magnitude reviews), and alignment meetings
* Track dependencies, blockers, and risks; escalate appropriately and coordinate cross\-team resolution
* Monitor sprint velocity, deliverables, and team output; continuously optimize processes for delivery efficiency


**Stakeholder Alignment \& Communication**
* Align internal stakeholders (engineering, product leadership, data teams) and external partners (Etraveli Group, airlines, consolidators) around priorities, timelines, and expectations
* Communicate operational status, KPIs, and business decisions clearly and concisely \- orally and in writing
* Facilitate regular sync meetings with engineering leadership, other product teams, and stakeholders
* Prepare status reports, milestone updates, and analytics dashboards for leadership visibility


**Product Definition \& Requirements**
* Translate high\-level business objectives and customer needs into clear, well\-documented product requirements and user stories
* Define acceptance criteria and work with QA to establish test cases
* Establish acceptance criteria and work with QA teams to build comprehensive test cases
* Create reusable components and standardized approaches across recipe integrations to improve quality and reduce duplicative work


**Strategic Analysis \& Decision\-Making**
* Conduct data\-backed analysis to inform prioritization decisions; evaluate impact against business value
* Work with architects, engineering managers, and product leaders to assess technical feasibility and design efficient solutions
* Identify opportunities for improvement in security, CI/CD, quality, and performance practices
* Monitor KPIs tied to product decisions and iterate based on results
* Root cause analysis of systemic product issues and recommend structural improvements


**Partnership with Engineering \& Architecture**
* Collaborate with engineering leads on solution architecture, ensuring alignment between product vision and technical implementation
* Work with platform and engineering teams to identify and resolve technical blockers
* Support architecture decisions that balance speed of delivery with long\-term platform health


 Job Requirements
   

  

* 3\+ years hands\-on experience in a product or program management role with significant operational responsibility
* Strong project management and organizational skills with ability to juggle multiple competing priorities
* Excellent communication skills across technical teams, product teams, and non\-technical stakeholders
* Strategic thinker with strong experience in data\-backed decision making
* Comfort with ambiguity; ability to move fast and make decisions with incomplete information
* Leadership skills: ability to bring teams together toward a common purpose and coordinate across multiple teams


**Technical \& Industry Knowledge**
* Knowledge of software architecture, REST, cloud platforms, platform engineering, and microservices
* Experience working as a hands\-on QA engineer or application developer would be advantageous
* Travel industry experience \- particularly with airline APIs, NDC standards, or GDS/PSS systems
* Experience building airline or flight content integrations
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, monitoring tools, and production observability platforms


**Personal Attributes**
* Output and delivery driven; results\-oriented mindset
* Resilient with ability to thrive under pressure and competing demands
* Proficient in communication: clear, concise, and professional across contexts
* Passion for problem\-solving, root cause analysis, and operational excellence
* Highly accountable team player; takes ownership of outcomes


**Benefits**
 We offer an opportunity to work with a young, dynamic, and a growing team composed of high\-caliber professionals. We value professionalism and promote a culture where individuals are encouraged to do more and be more. If you feel you share our passion for excellence, and growth, then look no further. We have an ambitious mission, and we need a world\-class team to make it a reality. Upgrade to a First Class team!
   

  

 At Tripstack, we proudly believe in embracing diversity. This is true for our team, clients, communities and stakeholders. We are an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating a safe, healthy and accessible environment. We encourage applications regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or any other grounds protected by law. Please let us know if you need any accommodations during any part of the recruitment process.

 Learn more about us at www.tripstack.com

 **Customer Obsessed**

 **Default to Disclosure** 
 by operating with transparency and integrity, ensuring trust and accountability. Employees, researchers, customers, and partners

 by fostering empowerment, inclusion, respect, and accountability.
   

  

**Product Manager, Agentic Vulnerability Elimination**

 Position Summary
   

  

 HackerOne is seeking a hands\-on, technically curious Product Manager to join the team building Agentic Vulnerability Elimination (AVE). AVE is how HackerOne brings AI agents and human expertise together to validate, prioritize, and remediate vulnerabilities at scale. The agents do the heavy lifting on every finding, while our triage analysts and security researchers keep them accurate and trustworthy. In this role, you will drive improvements to the quality and performance of these agents and the harness they run in, working closely with our Pune triage and offensive security teams and partnering closely with product development teams based in India, the Netherlands, and the U.K.
   

  

 This is an ideal role for someone who is energized by AI, comfortable getting into the details of how an agent actually behaves, and motivated by close collaboration with the operators, security researchers, and customers who use and pressure\-test our products every day.
   

  

 This hybrid role is located in Pune, India, and reports to the Principal Product Manager for Agentic Vulnerability Elimination.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
 Success in the Product Manager role will be accomplished by delivering on the responsibilities below in alignment with the Values and Principles that define how we work at HackerOne:
   

  

* Lead the definition and delivery of improvements to AI agent quality, performance, and cost management across validation, prioritization, exploitation, deduplication, and remediation, balancing model capabilities, operational workflows, customer outcomes, and engineering tradeoffs.
* Own the evolution of the evaluation framework and agent harness, establishing scalable evaluation methodologies, quality gates, and feedback loops that improve agentic capabilities over time.
* Partner with triage, engineering, offensive security researchers, and product teams to align priorities, influence product direction, and translate operational workflows into scalable, AI\-driven product capabilities.
* Work closely with our offensive security researchers to validate exploitability, adversarially stress\-test agent decisions, and improve how the agents reason about real\-world attack scenarios.
* Partner with customer\-facing teams in EMEA and the US to join customer calls and understand user workflows, gather feedback, and keep agent improvements grounded in real\-world needs.
* Define the product health metrics for your area, design experimentation frameworks, and use evidence to make prioritization decisions that improve customer and business outcomes.
* Own significant product initiatives, independently defining problem statements, success metrics, and execution plans while influencing the broader product strategy alongside senior product leadership and partnering closely with development teams based in India, the Netherlands, and the U.K.
* Navigate ambiguous product problems where customer needs, AI capabilities, and security workflows are still emerging, bringing structure, prioritization, and clear execution plans to cross\-functional teams.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of product management experience, ideally on technical or AI/LLM products at high\-growth tech or SaaS companies.
* A track record of building products with close cross\-functional collaboration across engineering, design, and operations.
* Hands\-on experience with LLM\-based solutions, including prompting, evaluations, quality control, and the practical realities of building features on top of generative AI.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort working directly with data to define metrics, run experiments, and make decisions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build alignment among technical and operational staff.
* Experience working with distributed/async product development teams in different time zones.
* Based in Pune or willing to relocate, and able to work on\-site there on a hybrid basis.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
